'''''Deuterocohnia brevifolia''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Bromeliaceae]].<ref name=POWO>{{cite web |url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:972903-1 |title= Deuterocohnia brevifolia (Griseb.) M.A.Spencer & L.B.Sm. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=May 28, 2024}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{cite web |url= https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/6CPFJ |title= Deuterocohnia brevifolia (Griseb.) M.A.Spencer & L.B.Sm. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Catalogue of Life |publisher=Species 2000 |access-date=May 28, 2024}}</ref> This species is [[Native plant|native]] to [[Argentina]] and [[Bolivia]],<ref name="GRIN">{{GRIN|id=403255|name=''Deuterocohnia brevifolia'' (Griseb.) M.A.Spencer & L.B.Sm.|accessdate=21 March 2010}}</ref> but is also popular as a potted houseplant or [[ground cover]] elsewhere.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.eastbaytimes.com/2010/01/29/ruths-tips-abromeitiella-brevifolia/|title=Ruth’s Tips: Abromeitiella brevifolia|date=January 29, 2010|work=[[East Bay Times]]}}</ref> A terrestrial species, it prefers sun or light shade and can grow in large dense mats of leaves given proper conditions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.llifle.com/Encyclopedia/BROMELIADS/Family/Bromeliaceae/14678/Deuterocohnia_brevifolia|title=Deuterocohnia brevifolia|website=www.llifle.com|access-date=2018-06-14}}</ref>
